task.description:
Run the DSL-06 test suite and produce a test report.

Steps:
1. Run zig build test and capture output
2. Check specifically that all DSL-06 tests pass:
   - DSL-06: MAX_EVAL_DEPTH constant exists
   - DSL-06: evaluate delegates to evaluateNode with max depth
   - DSL-06: evaluateNode with remaining=1 evaluates leaf nodes but fails on binary
   - DSL-06: deep chain hits depth limit
   - DSL-06: 100 random expressions evaluate within bound
3. Run zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" — verify no output
4. Write test report to tests/reports/report-WF02-dsl06-20260527-step04.json
acceptance_criteria: No "error set" output from zig build

result.summary: All 5 DSL-06 unit tests passed. zig build and zig build test exit 0. No error set issues found.
